::: {#rem-prediction-error}
#### Prediction errors and residuals

The prediction in @def-prediction-error can be a [fitted value](#def-fitted-value),
for an observation used to fit the model,
or a prediction for an observation that was not used to fit the model.
Prediction error is oriented the same way as
[estimation error](estimation.qmd#def-estimation-error):
estimate minus true value.

$$
\begin{aligned}
\prederr &= \fitted - \outvar
&& \text{(prediction error)}\\
\erf{\hparam} &= \hparam - \param
&& \text{(estimation error)}
\end{aligned}
$$

For a fitted value,
the prediction error is the negative of the residual
(@thm-prediction-error-residual),
so the two differ only in orientation.

The [expected value](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) of the squared prediction error
for a [new observation](model-validation.qmd#def-new-observation)
at a given [covariate](model-validation.qmd#def-covariate) value
is the [expected squared prediction error](model-validation.qmd#def-epe).
:::
